docs:
New Next.js project only (same flow as https://ui.shadcn.com/create):
  npx shadcn@latest init --template next -y "https://uiception.com/r/landing-page-v2.json"

This scaffolds Next.js + shadcn, then installs the full site.

Edit all page copy (name, tagline, event meta, register questions) in lib/site.ts. The home CTA links to /register, which runs a multi-step Questionnaire and posts via lib/actions.ts — replace the stub body with your own persistence / email / CRM call. Successful submits toast via Base UI Toast (https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/toast). ThemeProvider (next-themes) drives light/dark class tokens used by the toaster.

Preview at /view/landing-page-v2 (and /view/landing-page-v2/register).
